Precision. Partnership. Trust in Every Measure.

At Transcat, we help the world’s most critical industries stay accurate, compliant, and competitive. As the leading provider of accredited calibration services and equipment and asset management solutions for customers in high-cost-of-failure environments, our goal is to ensure compliance and support our customers in reaching new levels of excellence. We set new benchmarks in the industry, delivering value across the globe and testing and verifying over 10 million data points annually. With Transcat, you’ll have trust in every measure and the confidence to focus on what matters – your business.

Leading Test & Measurement Equipment Product Lines Offered

Project execution in 50+ global locations
8 of the top 10 Medical Device Companies trust their operational readiness to Transcat

Discover the Right Solutions for Your Industry

Transcat understands the complexities of the aviation industry, and why accuracy is critical. Our highly skilled technicians help ensure that your critical ground support equipment is accurate and in compliance by providing calibration and GSE services on-site nationwide or at our full-service, ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab . Learn more about our ongoing process of procedural training, MRO and FBO specializations, and how we ensure an exceptional quality of service for our customers.

Transcat partners with all categories of chemical manufacturers to help them meet stringent compliance, documentation, and traceability requirements. Our highly skilled teams provide specialized calibration services for equipment and tools to assist chemical manufacturers in meeting these challenging regulatory requirements, reducing downtime and costs, and ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and safety of their production processes and products.

Clinical and diagnostic laboratories play a vital role in healthcare – and Transcat plays a vital role in helping them stay efficient and compliant. Transcat has extensive experience and in-depth knowledge of the processes and regulations surrounding clinical labs. Find out how we can help your lab reach and maintain regulatory compliance through validation, calibration, and compliance services tailored to your specific test instruments and requirements.

Your organization supports healthcare research and drives innovation. Let Transcat support you with reliable, efficient instrument calibration to ensure the reliability and validity of your research data. Transcat has the experience to help CRO labs comply with regulations through validation and compliance services tailored to their specific test instruments and lab environments. Find out how and explore the wide breadth of industries we serve.

Transcat provides specialized calibration services that address the unique needs of the food and beverage manufacturing industry - including principles such as the FDA’s Critical Control Points (HACCP). We can help you meet even the strictest sanitization and quality control requirements with efficient, quality calibration and maintenance of your equipment and test and measurement tools. Discover how our calibration experts can support your quality control systems and reduce the risk of contamination and waste.

Tight regulatory standards require strong, skilled partners. Transcat can help government and municipality-owned services such as utilities, environmental monitoring operations, and testing entities uphold the standards and regulations they enforce with efficient, high-quality calibration and maintenance of their equipment and test and measurement instruments. Explore our range of distinct service options available and find the one that best suits your needs.

GSE (or ground support equipment) plays an integral role in aircraft operations – and Transcat is the partner they can rely on to help ensure the speed, efficiency, and accuracy of their equipment. Transcat helps GSE crews minimize downtime for aircraft before, in between, and after flights with GSE certification, calibration, maintenance, and repair services for the aviation and aerospace industries.

Transcat offers specialized biomedical instrument calibration and repair services for applications throughout hospital departments – from diagnostics labs to operating rooms and everything in between. By providing quality calibration of your medical equipment and instruments, we can help your hospital maintain quality standards and comply with even the most stringent regulations.

Your work helps improve lives every day. Transcat can help improve the way you work – and your work life - with expert equipment and tool calibration services that support regulatory compliance regulations, product and process safety, and quality to help ensure effective and accurate results. Learn how we can support your operations and help you stay in compliance with the FDA's Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP, GCP, GLP, and cGMP).

At Transcat, we help the world’s most critical industries stay accurate, compliant, and competitive. As a trusted provider of calibration services, compliance solutions, and test and measurement equipment distribution and rentals, we bring precision and reliability to every customer interaction — from the lab floor to the production line.
Our mission is to deliver best-in-class calibration, compliance, and asset management solutions that ensure safety, quality, and operational excellence for our customers.
Our vision is to become the premier provider of measurement and compliance services, empowering industries to advance with confidence through accuracy, innovation, and trust.

Founded in 1964, Transcat began as a regional calibration and test equipment provider. Over the decades, we’ve evolved into a nationwide industry leader serving highly regulated industries such as life sciences, aerospace, energy, and manufacturing.
From our first calibration lab to our robust digital compliance tools today, our growth has always been rooted in one principle: earn trust by delivering excellence.

With more than 25 calibration laboratories across North America and Ireland, and a growing portfolio of specialty services, Transcat remains committed to supporting our customers with scalable solutions and uncompromising accuracy.

Transcat is an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited provider offering calibration of electrical, mechanical, temperature, pressure, and dimensional instruments. Whether in-lab or onsite, we deliver compliant, auditable results with fast turnaround times.
Asset Management & Compliance Solutions

We offer industry-leading systems for asset tracking, documentation, and compliance assurance. From system implementation to ongoing support, we help simplify regulatory requirements and improve operational efficiency.

Transcat is a top distributor of electronic test and measurement equipment from trusted global brands. We offer new and used equipment, rentals, and leasing options to meet your needs and your budget.
From metrology consulting and program development to custom test solutions, our expert teams help solve unique challenges for regulated and technical environments.
We support mission-critical operations across diverse industries:
Life Sciences – Regulatory-ready calibration & compliance
Aerospace & Defense – High-precision, high-reliability solutions
Energy & Utilities – Field-ready tools and expertise
Manufacturing & Industrial – Scalable support for complex operations
Whether you’re a lab manager ensuring FDA compliance, a QA lead preparing for an audit, or a technician in need of rapid equipment turnaround — Transcat is here to support you.
Unmatched Accreditation: ISO/IEC 17025-accredited across our lab network.
Global Footprint: 25+ strategically located calibration labs across North America and Ireland.
Customer-Centric Approach: Dedicated account management and responsive service teams.
Digital Innovation : Leading tools and platforms for managing compliance, scheduling, and traceability.
Trusted Brands: Authorized distributor for over 500 manufacturers.
We don’t just deliver services — we deliver peace of mind.
Behind every successful partnership is a team committed to excellence. Meet the experienced leaders guiding Transcat's innovation, strategy, and service delivery.
